name: LaserFlow-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Sharp full-height beam and a bright pool with no cursor sitting over the glow.

tagline: A pink beam of light rises from a bright pool on black.
summary: One thin shaft of pink light climbs from a soft horizontal pool at the bottom of a black stage, with faint streaks drifting along it. The beam leans a little as the pointer moves.
appearance: A near-black stage holds a single slender vertical shaft of hot pink light rising from a wide, soft elliptical pool near the bottom. The pool fades outward into darkness, with a faint haze around the base.
behaviour: The shaft fades in on load and keeps a slow flicker while fine streaks drift down its length. Moving the pointer tilts the beam and haze slightly, then it eases back.
search_phrases: pink laser beam on black background
vertical glow beam for hero section
use_when: A dark hero, event page or album cover needs one dramatic shaft of light.
avoid_when: Light themes or busy layouts: it needs black space to read and carries no content.
customise: Beam colour, flow speed, wisp density, fog intensity, offsets and sizing are props. The shader body and its named constants need a source edit.
weight_why: A WebGL fragment shader renders every frame with layered noise and fog.

a11y.note: Decorative canvas with no role or label; the motion never stops and ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: All six frames look nearly identical, so the drifts and tilt are hard to see.
polish_why: Clean falloff and a believable glow; the clip shows almost no movement.
